That rule is VitePress's default theme style (`vitepress/dist/client/theme-default/styles/base.css`), which applies **only to the host page's `<body>`** in the outer document, not inside the demo iframe.

### How the demo iframe isolation works

1. **Two-layer iframe sandbox:**
   - **Outer frame** ([tools/demo/runner/index.html](tools/demo/runner/index.html)): Loads `/play/index.html` with its own isolated stylesheet ([tools/demo/runner/runner.css](tools/demo/runner/runner.css)).
   - **Inner frame** ([tools/demo/runner/main.ts](tools/demo/runner/main.ts#L321-L326)): Renders the demo via a sandboxed `<iframe class="runner__result" srcdoc="...">`.
2. **CSS isolation:**
   - `srcdoc` creates an isolated document tree. Styles from the parent document (such as VitePress's `body` rule, `.vp-doc`, and `--vp-c-*` variables) cannot pierce the iframe boundary.
   - The stylesheets injected into the demo (`cssUrls`) only include Instructure token and component sheets (`base.css`, `components.css`, `site-themes.css`, etc.)—none contain `--vp-c-bg` or VitePress rules.
3. **Background hierarchy in the runner:**
   - **Inner iframe `<html>`**: Sets `background: var(--instui-color-background-page)` from [formats/components/src/rules/base/base.css](formats/components/src/rules/base/base.css#L22).
   - **Inner iframe `<body>`**: Defaults to `margin: 0; padding: var(--instui-spacing-space-md, 1rem);` with no background set (transparent, showing the `<html>` page background).
   - **Demo CSS** ([docs/demos/pendo/style.css](docs/demos/pendo/style.css)): Injected into the inner iframe's `<head><style>` block, so any background defined on `body`, `html`, or `.pendo-showcase` applies directly to the demo.

If DevTools displayed `body { background-color: var(--vp-c-bg); ... }`, DevTools had the top-level host page's `<body>` selected rather than the nested `#document > html > body` inside `iframe.pantoken-demo__frame` $\rightarrow$ `iframe.runner__result`.

look in the browser to see it:
http://localhost:5173/api/renderers/pendo/src/

the background of hte iframe body is white which is from the inherited style. the background of the iframe html is the proper page color.
